remarks: Welcome to 24 Taylor Drive! Beautifully maintained 3-bedroom Cape nestled on a cul-de-sac in Cos Cob. Enjoy the ease of being just moments from the train, elementary school, library, and local shops-an unbeatable location for everyday living. Inside, a spacious and thoughtfully designed layout with an inviting living room and wood-burning fireplace. The kitchen blends style and function, perfect for both daily living and entertaining. Seamless indoor-outdoor flow creates versatile outdoor living space ideal for relaxing or gathering with friends and family. Whether you're searching for the perfect first home or looking to downsize without compromise, this turn-key property offers comfort, convenience, and community all in one. Don't miss the opportunity to make it yours.
